verdict.rationale: Rippling's own marketing documents a custom workflow builder that triggers automated actions on events, such as a reminder to pay a bonus or a Slack alert based on a Zendesk ticket. Rule-based automation of permissions and app provisioning as roles change is also claimed. However, all evidence is brief marketing copy with no detail on rule authoring, conditions, or trigger types, and nothing shows AI-assisted rule definition. Missing for 10: documentation of trigger/event types and rule conditions, detail on action types and rule configuration, AI-native rule authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Easily build custom workflows to notify people of important changes and automate administrative tasks—like triggering a reminder to pay a bonus.
trigger workflows–like automating a Slack alert based on a Zendesk ticket
